description: Allows the addition, modification and deletion of policies in a Consul cluster using the agent. For more details on using and configuring ACLs, see https://www.consul.io/docs/guides/acl.html.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Host of the Consul agent. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name that should be associated with the policy, this is opaque to Consul.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which the consul agent is running. Default: 8500

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: Rule document that should be associated with the current policy.

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to http and can be set to https for secure connections. Default: "http"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the policy should be present or absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token to use for authorization.

parameters.name: valid_datacenters
parameters.description: Valid datacenters for the policy. All if list is empty.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent. Choices: false true ← (default)

return_values.name: operation
return_values.description: The operation performed. Returned: changed Sample: "update"

return_values.name: policy
